description: This file provides database connection and schema management for a mobile repair website backend. It defines functions for initializing database tables, fetching and updating data related to services, bookings, customer requests, admins, and site content.

methods.name: str get_db_path()
methods.description: Returns the SQLite database path, checking environment variable or defaulting to a local database file.

methods.name: None init_schema()
methods.description: Initializes the database schema by creating necessary tables and default entries if they do not exist.

methods.name: list[dict] list_services()
methods.description: Retrieves a list of services ordered by display order.

methods.name: dict get_site_content(keys: list[str])
methods.description: Fetches specific site content entries based on provided keys.

methods.name: int create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)
methods.description: Inserts a new customer request into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: int create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str)
methods.description: Creates a booking record with minimal info and returns the new booking ID.

methods.name: list[dict] list_bookings(limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Returns a list of recent bookings, for admin view.

methods.name: dict|None get_booking_by_id(booking_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches detailed booking info by ID.

methods.name: dict|None get_latest_booking_by_phone(phone: str)
methods.description: Fetches the most recent booking for a specified phone number.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_status(booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
methods.description: Updates a booking's status and notes, returning the updated record.

ctags.name: create_booking
ctags.pattern: /^def create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str) -> int:$/

ctags.name: create_customer_request
ctags.pattern: /^def create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str) /
ctags.signature: (name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)

ctags.name: update_booking_status
ctags.pattern: /^def update_booking_status(booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None) -> dict | None/
ctags.signature: (booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
